description: This PHP source file defines a unit test class `LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest` within the `OrangeHRM` project. The class tests the functionality of LDAP synchronization service (`LDAPSyncService`) related to creating and updating system users based on LDAP directory data. It contains multiple test methods that mock LDAP data and entity states to verify correct system user creation, update, and handling of edge cases in LDAP synchronization.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceCreateSystemUsersTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the LDAP synchronization for creating system users in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up mock services, loads fixture data, and verifies user and employee records are correctly created or updated after LDAP sync operations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, including mock services and fixture directory path.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests the creation of system users from LDAP data, verifying the total count of users after synchronization.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithLocalUsers
methods.description: Verifies LDAP sync creates additional users when local user data is preloaded, checking user counts before and after sync.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithEmployeeMapping
methods.description: Tests LDAP sync with employee mapping, also verifying modifications to employee last names after sync.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenUsernameChanged
methods.description: Checks LDAP sync behavior when a user's username changes, ensuring old user is replaced by the new username.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsNotChanged
methods.description: Verifies that no duplicate users are created when LDAP data fields remain unchanged across syncs.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWhenFieldsChanged
methods.description: Tests system behavior when LDAP data fields (such as email) are modified between syncs, ensuring employees are updated accordingly.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsersWithNonUniqueEmployeeIdAndWorkEmail
methods.description: Checks LDAP sync handling when multiple employees share non-unique employee IDs or work emails, verifying correct user and employee records.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Helper method that constructs mock LDAPUser objects with predefined attributes, simulating LDAP directory entries for testing.
